Regular Season Calendar

The Club division ultimate season consists of two major parts: the regular season and the postseason championships series. The 13-week regular season begins in June and includes a variety of independently organized tournaments and premier USA Ultimate Triple Crown Tour (TCT) events. TCT events are designed to showcase the nation’s top teams, which fall into one of four tiers based on the previous season’s results – Pro, Elite, Select and Classic.

The postseason begins in mid-September as more than 600 teams compete in a series of sectional and regional qualifiers in an attempt to earn an invitation to ultimate’s most storied and prestigious event – the USA Ultimate National Championships.
